products.description:
Deploy Device Compliance Policies correctly on a GCC High tenant

Device Compliance Policies in GCC High is not the Commercial portal with a different sign-in — the sovereign-cloud admin URLs differ and some capabilities lag, are limited, or are absent versus Commercial. This is the Government (GCC High) edition: device compliance policies authored for the US sovereign cloud, with the correct portals, endpoints, and Commercial-vs-GCC-High parity gaps called out so a government tenant is configured correctly — not with Commercial steps that silently fail.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — device compliance policies on GCC High and how the US sovereign cloud differs from Commercial (portals, endpoints, feature parity), plus an explicit Commercial vs GCC High — what's different section and the standard deployment model.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite with how to verify and implement each (GCC High tenant, US Gov licensing (G3/G5 Gov), roles, sovereign portal access, endpoints/URLs allowed through filtering).
  • Implementation Guide — exact ordered steps using the GCC High portals, with GCC-High-only caveats/parity notes inline at the step where they matter.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — discovery, validation, reporting, safe remediation, and a target-group builder — all connecting to US Gov Graph endpoints (-Environment USGov).
  • GCC High parity reference plus Testing & Troubleshooting with pass/fail gates and GCC-High-specific gotchas.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Device Compliance Policies deployed correctly on GCC High — right portals, right endpoints, parity gaps handled — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • DCPG-Discovery.ps1 — inventory device compliance policies, assignments, and actions on a GCC High tenant
    • DCPG-Remediation.ps1 — safely correct common GCC High compliance-policy scoping drift (default -WhatIf)
    • DCPG-Report.ps1 — per-device compliance rollup for a GCC High tenant (status and audit evidence)
    • DCPG-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build/grow the pilot and wave target groups for GCC High rollout (default -WhatIf)
    • DCPG-Validation.ps1 — pass/fail check that the named GCC High compliance objects exist and are pilot-scoped

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
